Preserve stack geometry, stack checks/canaries, domain ownership and public Task/native field ABIs

Migrate hosted/cooperative/Task/OF816 initialization and current observers together

dp_boundary_observer.scope: Test-only RAM, restored; not a production reservation. Bootstrap and runtime sentinel phases do not overlap.

host.reason: Pre-publication source commits absent from the public repository

cold_restart.stale_reader_check: All identity, count and seed bytes poisoned before repeat Adopt/Init

of816.scope: Five-second autoboot and clock wrap; final-second cancel, Forth handoff; shell/prime, disk HELLO, TYPE, CAT/WC pipeline, EXIT, BYE and occupied IOCB cleanup

test_repairs: The original stack-limit fixture compiled Work without a local frame, so raising its floor tested a later call. Work now has a real local array and the observer requires a nonzero compiler frame.
The isolated bank-policy fixture used owner 5 as invalid, although 5 is the current heap owner; use M_OWNER_HEAP+1.

The pinned bridge exposes PC16/S8 and cannot directly break in upper code. The DP observer checks and relocates whole entry/exit instructions through a temporary bank-zero rendezvous, captures S with TSC, and restores patched bytes. The production body and DP geometry are unchanged.
limits: Focused development checks, not release qualification.
External DP canaries are gone; out-of-range writes can corrupt adjacent domains.
Reclaimed holes are not registered with the general heap; manifest remains protected until startup_complete.
VBXE aperture is reserved but hardware mapping, GEM rendering and GUI stack enlargement remain future work.
Only the checked four/eight public Task layouts are supported.
